items.name: Answer questions about an uploaded PDF with source evidence
items.summary: Upload one PDF and ask focused questions.
items.description: Upload one PDF and ask focused questions. The native Docling extension extracts the document text, and the model answers with short verbatim quotations and explicit unknowns. Up to 60,000 characters of text are analysed; the report says when a longer document was read only in part. Requires the Docling extension 0.3.0 or later, a configured Docling service and a model connection. No public-URL fallback, persistent chat memory, guaranteed page citations or external actions.

items.name: Check an appointment request against service and duration rules
items.summary: Paste a client's appointment request and your service list with maximum durations.
items.description: Paste a client's appointment request and your service list with maximum durations. The model reads the requested service, duration and preferred time; fixed rules then decide whether the request fits, is outside the rules or needs clarification, and the report shows why with verbatim quotes. No calendar lookup, booking or messages.

items.name: Classify customer feedback with allowed tags
items.summary: Classify unprocessed customer feedback in Google Sheets with your allowed tags, sentiment and emotions.
items.description: Classify unprocessed customer feedback in Google Sheets with your allowed tags, sentiment and emotions. Reads the Tags and Feedbacks tables, processes rows with a blank Status in batches of 10, and writes classifications and the supplied processing date back to Feedbacks. Unmatched feedback receives suggested AI tags and Needs Review status. Use it to organize a product feedback backlog. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3, an AI model and dedicated contiguous plain-value tables of at most 100 rows each, with one writer. Disabled on import; select the model and validate and enable the included agents, skills and child workflows before activation. Forms, schedules and trusted dates need separate setup. Adapted from https://n8n.io/workflows/9881/; 15 synthetic offline scenarios passed, with no live API or import verification.

items.name: Create a social media content pack from an article
items.summary: Prepare English social drafts from one public HTTP/HTTPS article, a campaign brief and an audience profile.
items.description: Prepare English social drafts from one public HTTP/HTTPS article, a campaign brief and an audience profile. Returns separate LinkedIn, Instagram and X text fields, a proposed visual brief and a human review report. A dedicated Social Copywriter uses the configured native model provider. Native checks reject empty drafts and X text longer than 280 characters including spaces and links. Source coverage is disclosed, with at most 30,000 reader-returned characters supplied for drafting. No image generation, publishing, scheduling or sending.

items.name: Create a structured research-paper brief with evidence
items.summary: Create a research-paper brief from an uploaded PDF and your research focus.
items.description: Create a research-paper brief from an uploaded PDF and your research focus. Docling extracts the text and the model returns the title, authors, research question, method, findings with verbatim quotes, limitations and relevance to your focus. Use it to prepare an evidence-based literature review or reading note. The report flags quotes absent from the extracted text. Analyses at most 60,000 characters and discloses partial coverage; extraction can omit content. Requires a configured Docling service and AI model.

items.name: Create Zendesk tickets from new Typeform responses
items.summary: Create private Zendesk tickets from trusted Typeform responses.
items.description: Create private Zendesk tickets from trusted Typeform responses. Supply a verified, normalized form submission, expected form ID and destination organization ID. The workflow searches for an existing requester or supplies a new requester's name and email, then returns the created ticket ID and response. Answers must be ordered as body text, requester name and email. Use it for form-to-helpdesk intake. Disabled on import; configure your Zendesk HTTPS subdomain and existing internal-use API-token secrets zendesk_username (email/token) and zendesk_api_token. A dedicated project with retry_max_attempts=0 is required for immediate requester-lookup-error fallback. Configure trusted Typeform verification separately; no subscription or OAuth flow is included. Offline fixture qualification only. Setup and limits: https://github.com/Flow-Steward/workflows/blob/main/docs/templates/ap_typeform_zendesk/README.md

items.name: Daily security incident digest
items.summary: Email a daily patrol and security incident digest from a Google Sheets log.
items.description: Email a daily patrol and security incident digest from a Google Sheets log. Supply the Security Log spreadsheet, a trusted start/end reporting window and a supervisor address; the workflow lists matching reports in time order and marks whether urgent items are included. An empty window sends no email. Use it for a supervisor's daily activity handover. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3, Outgoing Email/SMTP 0.3.1 and a dedicated contiguous plain-value log of at most 100 rows, with one writer. Disabled on import; validate setup before enabling. The schedule, source forms and trusted timestamps require separate setup. Adapted from https://n8n.io/workflows/20438/; the incident workflow set passed 20 synthetic offline scenarios, with no live API or import verification.

items.name: Draft a customer email reply from approved policies
items.summary: Paste a customer email and optional approved policy to receive separate category, boolean human-escalation flag, subject, reply body and review route, plus a r…
items.description: Paste a customer email and optional approved policy to receive separate category, boolean human-escalation flag, subject, reply body and review route, plus a readable report. Uses a native model provider and reusable policy skill. Missing policy permits only a neutral acknowledgement requiring human review. Manual input only; mailbox reading, Gmail draft creation, sending and account changes are not implemented.

items.name: Draft personalized marketing emails from company research
items.summary: Draft personalized English outreach from one public company webpage, a recipient profile and an approved campaign brief.
items.description: Draft personalized English outreach from one public company webpage, a recipient profile and an approved campaign brief. Returns two subjects, an initial email, a separate follow-up and a personalization note as individual fields plus a review report. Draft-only mode is the default. Optional initial-email sending requires a recipient and human approval of the exact address, subject and body; follow-ups are never sent automatically. Uses the native provider and Outgoing Email extensions; an approved email is sent through the project's Outgoing Email connection. Recipient profile text is sent to the configured model provider; include only appropriate information.

items.name: Export public webpages to a source CSV
items.summary: Export a list of 1 to 100 public webpage URLs to an ordered CSV and page records.
items.description: Export a list of 1 to 100 public webpage URLs to an ordered CSV and page records. Each URL uses the shared public reader. Failed reads become individual rows with status and error details while readable pages are preserved; repeated URLs remain separate records. Missing page titles fall back to the requested URL. The report shows readable and total page counts. Download the generated CSV from Job Details. Returns pages and CSV metadata; first-class returned File mapping and optional database storage are not connected. No model rewriting, sign-in, linked-page discovery or external database updates.

items.name: Invoice reminders, escalation and weekly aging
items.summary: Send invoice reminders, escalate overdue accounts and email a weekly receivables aging report.
items.description: Send invoice reminders, escalate overdue accounts and email a weekly receivables aging report. Reads the Invoices Google Sheets table using your supplied date, reminder stages, escalation day and closed statuses. Sends reminders through SMTP, records accepted stages in the table, and sends escalations to your chosen internal address. The aging report groups open balances by age and currency for finance. Use it for a small accounts-receivable ledger. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3 and Outgoing Email/SMTP 0.3.1; use a dedicated contiguous plain-value table of at most 100 rows and one writer. Disabled on import; validate setup and the included child workflow before activation. Scheduling and trusted current dates need separate setup. Adapted from https://n8n.io/workflows/20173/; 34 synthetic offline scenarios passed, with no live API or import verification.

items.name: Monthly security incident review
items.summary: Email a monthly security operations review from a Google Sheets incident log.
items.description: Email a monthly security operations review from a Google Sheets incident log. Supply the Security Log spreadsheet, a trusted reporting window and a supervisor address. Fixed calculations count reports, incidents and urgent items, and group reports by site; an AI agent writes a short review and practical suggestion from that evidence. An empty window sends no email. Use it for an operations manager's monthly review. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3, Outgoing Email/SMTP 0.3.1, an AI model and a dedicated contiguous plain-value log of at most 100 rows, with one writer. Disabled on import; configure and validate the model and included agent/skill before activation. Forms, schedules and trusted timestamps need separate setup. Adapted from https://n8n.io/workflows/20438/; the incident workflow set passed 20 synthetic offline scenarios, with no live API or import verification.

items.name: Notify and fulfill trusted Stripe charge events
items.summary: Notify Telegram about a trusted Stripe charge and send a customer confirmation for successful payments.
items.description: Notify Telegram about a trusted Stripe charge and send a customer confirmation for successful payments. Supply a verified charge event, connection references and a parent folder ID. After the Telegram notification, exact status succeeded creates a Google Drive folder and sends a generic SMTP email; amounts remain in raw minor units. Use it as a payment-notification and folder-creation starting point. Disabled on import; configure Telegram 1.3.2, SMTP 0.3.1 and the documented Google Drive create_file MCP folder action. Trusted Stripe event admission must be configured separately. Earlier effects remain if a later step fails; reconcile uncertain results before retrying. No subscription, replay ledger, folder sharing, compensation, automatic write retry or Sent-folder copy is included. Live OAuth/provider responses are untested. Setup and attribution: https://github.com/Flow-Steward/workflows/blob/main/docs/templates/make_payment_fulfillment_m3/README.md

items.name: Order export protocol with a durable queue
items.summary: Process order exports through a PostgreSQL queue with retries and manual recovery.
items.description: Process order exports through a PostgreSQL queue with retries and manual recovery. Supply an order and trusted delivery identity; the workflow calls HTTP services to validate the order, map its shipping method and create it, with operations alerts for failure paths. The durable journal holds later orders behind unfinished work. Use it to study or adapt an order-export recovery protocol; the endpoints are demos, not a real 3PL integration. Qualified with core 0.9.9 and PostgreSQL 1.4.0, not 1.4.1. Disabled on import; provision the companion SQL, replace demo endpoints and configure trusted ingress. Requires a dedicated project with concurrency_cap=1, immutable delivery identity/scope and one active invocation per delivery. Reconcile uncertain creates before recovery approval; no exactly-once guarantee or exact Make parity. SQL: https://github.com/Flow-Steward/workflows/blob/main/docs/templates/m5_order_failsafe/queue-schema.sql . Setup: https://github.com/Flow-Steward/workflows/blob/main/docs/templates/m5_order_failsafe/README.md .

items.summary: Paste one candidate CV and explicit job-related criteria to receive a line-cited evidence matrix, missing information and neutral follow-up questions for a hum…
items.description: Paste one candidate CV and explicit job-related criteria to receive a line-cited evidence matrix, missing information and neutral follow-up questions for a human reviewer. Uses the configured native LLM provider extension. No candidate ranking, hire/reject decision, contact discovery, Drive ingestion, Sheets updates or messages.

items.name: Qualify a lead CSV with explicit size and budget rules
items.summary: Upload a lead CSV, choose Comma (default), Semicolon or Pipe as its separator, and set inclusive employee/budget thresholds.
items.description: Upload a lead CSV, choose Comma (default), Semicolon or Pipe as its separator, and set inclusive employee/budget thresholds. Native tabular validation, number normalization and row-conservation checks produce qualified and human-review CSV queues with numeric counts. Required column names are lead_id, company, email, employees and budget. Unparseable numbers stop before queue creation; negative values and blank email remain in review. Budgets must be comparable before upload: currency is not read, verified or converted. Download CSVs from generated step files; callable File outputs and a Google Sheets connection are not connected. No model judgment, enrichment or outreach.

items.name: Research a company from its website
items.summary: Turn one public company webpage into an English company profile and a sales preparation brief.
items.description: Turn one public company webpage into an English company profile and a sales preparation brief. Enter the webpage URL and read the report in the run results. Separates observed facts, sales hypotheses and unanswered qualification questions. Uses Jina Reader and the model configured for Web Research Analyst through a Flow Steward LLM provider extension. Covers one page and at most its first 30,000 characters; does not search or crawl the rest of the website.

items.name: Review an uploaded invoice PDF
items.summary: Upload an invoice PDF.
items.description: Upload an invoice PDF. Docling extracts the text, the model reads the header fields, line items and printed totals, and fixed rules check that quantity x price, the line sum, subtotal + tax and the total agree. Returns the fields as separate outputs and a report that flags missing fields and arithmetic differences. Reads up to 20,000 characters of invoice text and says so when the document is longer. Nothing is approved, paid or posted.

items.name: Search an IMAP mailbox for new messages
items.summary: Search the INBOX of a connected IMAP mailbox and list the messages it holds, newest search page first.
items.description: Search the INBOX of a connected IMAP mailbox and list the messages it holds, newest search page first. Returns the message summaries (sender, subject, date, UID) and a readable report, ready for a following step such as a supplier email workflow. Reads only; no message is moved, flagged or deleted.

items.name: Security incident intake and escalation
items.summary: Classify patrol reports, save them to Google Sheets and email urgent incident alerts.
items.description: Classify patrol reports, save them to Google Sheets and email urgent incident alerts. Supply officer details, site, event description, trusted report ID and timestamp, plus supervisor and client addresses. The AI classifies severity and summarizes the report; the workflow appends it to Security Log and emails both recipients for urgent cases. Missing required details trigger a rejection email instead of a log entry. Use it for private-security incident intake. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3, Outgoing Email/SMTP 0.3.1 and an AI model. Use a dedicated contiguous plain-value log and one writer. Disabled on import; configure and validate the included agent/skill before activation. The form adapter and trusted timestamps need separate setup. Adapted from https://n8n.io/workflows/20438/; the incident workflow set passed 20 synthetic offline scenarios, with no live API or import verification.

items.name: Seller weekly property reports (20542)
items.summary: Email property sellers a weekly report of enquiries, viewings and viewer feedback.
items.description: Email property sellers a weekly report of enquiries, viewings and viewer feedback. Reads Listings20542, Leads20542 and Viewings20542 in Google Sheets, groups eligible properties by seller email, and sends one HTML report per seller with the agent copied privately. Reports include seven-day and lifetime activity, upcoming viewings, ratings and rule-based suggestions. Accepted sends update Last Report Sent At in the listings table. Use it for a real-estate agency's seller updates. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3 and Outgoing Email/SMTP 0.3.1; each dedicated contiguous plain-value table is limited to 100 rows, with one writer. items.name: Suggest meeting slots from participant availability
items.summary: Find meeting suggestions from 1 to 20 explicit participant windows using native IANA timezone conversion, interval intersection and slot calculation.
items.description: Find meeting suggestions from 1 to 20 explicit participant windows using native IANA timezone conversion, interval intersection and slot calculation. Returns typed UTC/local slots, normalized participants and separate unsent invitation subject/body. One window per participant; 15-minute candidate grid and at most 10 suggestions. Invalid dates, DST ambiguity and nonexistent times fail without guessing. No calendar lookup, booking or message sending.

items.name: Summarize a video transcript with source quotes
items.summary: Paste a video or podcast transcript and a reading brief and get a focused summary, an ordered outline where every point carries a verbatim quote, key takeaways…
items.description: Paste a video or podcast transcript and a reading brief and get a focused summary, an ordered outline where every point carries a verbatim quote, key takeaways and open questions. The report flags any quote the transcript does not contain. Works on supplied text only; it does not download videos or captions. Up to 60,000 characters are analysed.

items.name: Summarize sales CSV by region with a downloadable report
items.summary: Create a one-time regional sales review from an uploaded UTF-8 CSV.
items.description: Create a one-time regional sales review from an uploaded UTF-8 CSV. Configure exact source headers for order ID, region and revenue; choose automatic, comma, semicolon or tab separation, decimal-point or decimal-comma amounts, and an optional explicit currency. Native operations validate rows and unique order IDs, calculate revenue totals and order counts, and check complete coverage of 1–1000 regional groups before model interpretation. Space-grouped numbers must be cleaned before upload. Returns reusable regional_summary data and a non-empty model-assisted report; the CSV download is available in Job Details, not as a callable File output. Invalid, empty or oversized regional summaries stop with an error; intermediate job files may remain. No currency conversion or external updates.

items.name: Triage a support request into a suggested review queue
items.summary: Suggest review queues and draft a reply for one pasted customer support request.
items.description: Suggest review queues and draft a reply for one pasted customer support request. Supply a request reference, issue text, optional approved policy and optional queue labels. An AI agent classifies billing, technical, account-access or other issues; the workflow maps primary and supported secondary categories to suggested queues and returns a summary, evidence and unsent reply for human review. Use it to prepare a support handoff. Reads at most 12,000 request characters and 8,000 policy characters, with coverage disclosed. Requires a configured AI model. No helpdesk or inbox connection, actual assignment, resolution or sending is included.

items.name: Turn a meeting transcript into decisions and action items
items.summary: Paste a meeting transcript and get a summary, decisions, accepted action items with owner and due date as said, unaccepted proposals, open questions and a foll…
items.description: Paste a meeting transcript and get a summary, decisions, accepted action items with owner and due date as said, unaccepted proposals, open questions and a follow-up email draft. Each decision and action item carries a verbatim quote; the report flags any quote the transcript does not contain. Owners and dates are never guessed. Nothing is sent and no tasks are created. Up to 60,000 transcript characters are analysed.

items.name: Turn customer feedback into a prioritized action plan
items.summary: Turn pasted customer feedback into sentiment counts, themes and proposed actions.
items.description: Turn pasted customer feedback into sentiment counts, themes and proposed actions. Supply your product context and one unique ID: feedback record per line. An AI agent classifies records into positive, neutral, negative, mixed or unclassified groups; fixed checks verify every ID appears once and calculate the counts. Returns the ID lists and a report for product planning and human review. Accepts at most 100 records and 30,000 characters; duplicate or missing IDs and larger inputs stop before acceptance. Requires a configured AI model. CSV upload, external updates and customer messaging are not included.

items.name: Turn email messages into a digest and action queue
items.summary: Turn pasted email messages into a digest, action queue and unsent reply drafts.
items.description: Turn pasted email messages into a digest, action queue and unsent reply drafts. Supply each message's sender, subject and body, plus optional review preferences. The model extracts requests addressed to you with verbatim quotes, dates to watch and reply drafts, then returns a report and separate digest, action-item, date and draft fields. Use it to prepare a daily inbox review from text you supply. Analyses at most 60,000 characters. Requires an AI model; no inbox access, automatic IMAP message fetching, sending, archiving or task creation is included.

items.name: Weekly KPI HTML report

items.description: Email an HTML KPI report with calculated totals, averages and an AI executive summary. Reads a Google Sheets Metrics table, groups rows by metric name, calculates rounded whole-number totals and averages, and sends the report to your chosen recipient through SMTP. Use it for a small team's recurring management report. The supplied report date labels the email; it does not filter rows or establish week-over-week trends. Requires Google Workspace 0.3.3, Outgoing Email/SMTP 0.3.1, an AI model and a dedicated contiguous plain-value table of at most 100 rows, with one writer.
